title: Ecovyst Announces Chief Executive Officer Transition and Reaffirms Full-Year 2026 Guidance
summary: Ecovyst Inc. (NYSE: ECVT) ("Ecovyst" or the "Company"), a leading provider of regenerated sulfuric acid, virgin sulfuric acid, and sulfur dioxide and related derivatives, today announced that the Board of Directors of the Company has appointed current director David A. Bradley as Interim Chief Executive Officer effective November 17, 2026. Mr. Bradley replaces Kurt J. Bitting, who will be departing the Company.
